{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Read the sales data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert revenue to numeric, coercing errors to NaN
sales_df['revenue'] = pd.to_numeric(sales_df['revenue'], errors='coerce')

# Identify valid revenue entries
valid_revenue = sales_df['revenue'].notna()

# Filter for completed orders with valid revenue
completed_and_valid = sales_df[valid_revenue & (sales_df['status'] == 'completed')]

# Total revenue from completed orders with valid revenue
total_revenue = completed_and_valid['revenue'].sum()

# Output the result
total_revenue"}
